prompt: A single small handmade crescent-moon charm for a tender illustrated fairy-tale game. A thumb-sized carved honey-colored wooden crescent with a tiny five-point star carved into the lower curve, hanging from a short loop of muted crimson thread. The imperfect carving feels made by hand and treasured. Clean thin dark-navy outlines, flat cel shading with two restrained warm color tones, slight wood grain, a beautifully readable silhouette matching a Japanese anime storybook visual novel. Centered isolated whole object, vertical composition, ample transparent padding, facing almost straight toward viewer with a very slight three-quarter thickness. Fully transparent alpha background. No hand, no person, no scenery, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no metal necklace chain, no realistic photography.
